overview: GrowthMind AI is a stunning animated blog page showcasing an article about how AI is transforming digital marketing in 2026. Features a 3D hero, scroll-triggered animations, and a modern dark UI.

Dark gradient design with purple/blue/teal palette

Social share buttons and newsletter prompt
